_comment: Descriptions for the README repository-layout tree, keyed by repo-relative path. An empty string means 'listed, deliberately undescribed'. Regenerate with: python3 tools/repo-tree/repo-tree.py

tools: Scripts — see each tool's own README
tools/repo-tree: Regenerates the tree on this page
